name: Oconee
gaps: Source query returned 9335 rows; 9314 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.

Parcels are Parcels with owner (PARCELDATA_owner MapServer) (https://arcserver2.oconeesc.com/arcgis/rest/services/PARCELDATA_owner/MapServer/1). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
qPublic and Beacon property-appraiser links are stored as patterns and were not requested.
Owner phone and email are not ingested. SCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
No sale price / market / assessed values on public GIS — use qPublic AppID=1030.
No situs address field on PARCELDATA_owner — owner mailing only; situs via qPublic.
Zoning is citizen-initiated / sparse (12 base polygons); default CFD for most land — honest partial, not countywide district coverage.
